messages:
Maya (Marketing): quick sync — we need to rework the competitive battlecard for the partner webinar next week. main asks: crisp benchmark narrative, two SDR soundbites, and routing rules for inbound leads.
Diego (Product Marketing): +1. want the benchmarks to focus on inflight costs and long-context perf — customers keep asking about real-world econ, not just latency numbers.
Sam (Field): we need one-liners for reps: something to use on demos and emails. short, defensible.
Priya (Content): drafting wireframes for the one-pagers. can we agree on 3 top claims and 2 supporting datapoints each?
Maya (Marketing): propose claims: 1) predictable inference economics (cost controls + batching), 2) unified runtime across hosted/dedicated/private, 3) graceful fallbacks to keep apps online. keep them measurable.
Oliver (Sales Ops): for routing: enterprise-y leads (SAML/KMS/Private) -> sales AE queue; high-usage infra questions -> solutions eng; product-fit demos -> SDRs. we should add a 'benchmark interest' tag to inbound forms.
Diego (Product Marketing): benchmark notes: we ran a long-context chat workload (32k tokens window) and saw 1.8x lower per-token GPU cost vs CloudX baseline with no KV caching, and 2.3x improvement when prefix caching was enabled. need to make the methodology clear.
Priya (Content): careful on exact numbers — Legal Bot, any restrictions on public claims? @Legal Bot?
Legal Bot: Visibility: claims with comparative numbers are okay if we include test methodology and dates + link to raw results. avoid absolute statements like "always faster". include model names & config.
Ava (Design): will mock a slide with an eyeball-friendly metric: "tokens / $" bar chart + tiny methodology footnote. need the final numbers by EOD tomorrow.
Sam (Field): can we create two SDR scripts: one for "ops-focused" (latency/cost) and one for "platform security" (private deploys, KMS)? examples pls.
Maya (Marketing): draft SDR soundbites: 
- Ops script: "We help teams cut per-token costs on long-running chat and batch jobs while keeping single-digit tail latency—worth a 15 min runbook review?"
- Security script: "We offer the same API surface on private infrastructure with KMS/HSM integrations—would you like architecture docs?"
Priya (Content): I can shorten them to 1 liners for email subject/preview.
Diego (Product Marketing): add one data-backed pain line for each script. e.g., "customers saw up to 40% lower infra spend on bursty chat." keep the qualifier: "up to" and cite the cohort.
Oliver (Sales Ops): inbound form field addition: "I care most about: [Cost] [Latency] [Private deploy] [Throughput] [Other]". route based on top selection + ARR signal.
Ava (Design): will produce two 1-slide templates: "Webinar benchmark" and "SDR one-pager". needing approved copy by tomorrow noon.
Priya (Content): working on a short FAQ section: allowed competitor mentions, what to avoid (no subjective superiority claims), and suggested rebuttals vs Cloud APIs and infra vendors.
Maya (Marketing): suggested rebuttals (draft): against Cloud APIs — "you can get quick access, but we help you make it predictable at scale and reduce unit economics risk"; against infra vendors — "they give raw control but you still need to build serving, autoscaling and model rollouts — we provide production-ready runtime + ops".
Diego (Product Marketing): tweak language: replace "we help" with "Redwood helps" and add a concrete example snippet: "A fintech team reduced per-query cost 30% by enabling prefix caching and recommended batching profiles."
Sam (Field): please give a short technical appendix we can paste in replies: include config snippets for batching and example curl for private deploy handshake.
Priya (Content): code snippet idea: ```bash curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"rwd-llm-7b","prompt":"..."}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate ``` will that cover it?
Diego (Product Marketing): yes + include a small note about recommended batch_size and kv_cache settings for long chats.
Maya (Marketing): action items:
- Diego: finalize benchmark table + methodology (due EOD tomorrow)
- Priya: draft SDR one-pagers + FAQ (due tomorrow noon)
- Ava: design slides & one-pagers (due tomorrow noon)
- Oliver: update inbound form + routing rules (due EOD)
- Sam: collect 2 field anecdotes for examples (due EOD)
Legal Bot: I'll cc Legal on the final wording before publish.
Priya (Content): acked. putting everything in the drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/launchsprints/warband-battlecard-v2 (placeholder link)
Maya (Marketing): cool. one more: please avoid the word "cheaper" in outbound claims; prefer "lower unit cost" or "more predictable spend" per Legal Bot.
Diego (Product Marketing): noted. I'll prepare a one-paragraph benchmark narrative we can read aloud on the webinar.
Ava (Design): will iterate on visual hooks for the "predictable spend" line.
Sam (Field): thanks all — will prep a 2-slide demo-ready pack for AEs.
Maya (Marketing): great — if no blockers, we'll push to partner webinar assets by EOD Thurs. react with :thumbsup: when you own an action.
Diego (Product Marketing): :thumbsup:
Priya (Content): :thumbsup:
Ava (Design): :thumbsup:
Oliver (Sales Ops): :thumbsup:
Sam (Field): :thumbsup:
